reasons: The cited p0046 clause is a textbook Customer-binding non-compete (24 months post-term, any territory, undefined 'any product or service that competes with Vendor'), which falls squarely in the rule's walk-away band, so a 'deviation' status is correct.

Full deletion of the paragraph matches the playbook's preferred position and the redline guidance ('delete the restriction on Customer'); deterministic checks confirm no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix, correctly cites the internal contradiction with § 12.3, and offers the narrowed fallback (single named product, term only, carve-outs) without lecturing.
Deletion is the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position here; no other paragraph needed changing since § 12.3 already affirms the absence of non-compete commitments.
